text: JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way . Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward. Role Summary We are seeking a Principal Architect to help lead the next generation of AI-enabled product, platform, and engineering capabilities across our organization. This is a senior individual contributor role operating at the highest levels of technical leadership. The ideal candidate will combine deep AI architecture expertise with strong enterprise architecture judgment, practical delivery experience, and the ability to influence teams across business units. This role will partner closely with business and technology leaders to shape product and platform architectures, define and uphold enterprise standards, and help our engineering organization adopt modern AI and AI-powered software delivery practices responsibly and effectively. Key Responsibilities Lead architecture for strategic AI initiatives across products, platforms, and shared enterprise capabilities Partner with business units, product leaders, and engineering teams to shape scalable, secure, and practical AI solution architectures Define and evolve architecture standards, reference patterns, and guardrails for AI solutions and AI-enabled software development Evaluate emerging AI technologies, platforms, and patterns, and guide the organization on where and how to adopt them Provide architectural leadership for capabilities, agentic workflows, AI orchestration, evaluations, AI observability, and AI governance Ensure AI solutions align with enterprise requirements for security, privacy, compliance, resiliency, observability, and maintainability Help engineering teams leverage AI-powered PDLC capabilities across coding, testing, documentation, analysis, and delivery workflows Guide architecture decisions across application, data, integration, platform, and operational concerns to avoid fragmented or duplicative solutions Mentor technical leads and senior engineers and contribute to raising the technical bar across the organization Participate in architecture reviews, technical strategy discussions, and investment decisions related to AI and platform modernization Required Qualifications Bachelor’s or masters degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience 12+ years of experience in software engineering, architecture, or technology leadership roles Significant experience designing and guiding enterprise-grade AI solutions in production environments Deep knowledge of modern AI architecture patterns, including LLM-based applications, retrieval systems, agentic workflows, prompt and tool orchestration, and evaluation approaches Strong architecture background across distributed systems, APIs, integration, data platforms, security, and cloud-native solutions Experience establishing architecture standards, reference architectures, and technical guardrails across multiple teams Proven ability to influence senior technical and business stakeholders without direct authority Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor communication from engineering teams to executive leadership Demonstrated ability to balance innovation, speed, risk management, and long-term maintainability Preferred Qualifications Experience working in a large enterprise, platform-oriented environment Experience with AI governance, responsible AI, model risk, privacy, and security controls Familiarity with cloud AI platforms and services, vector search, AI gateways, observability, and production AI operations Experience helping engineering organizations adopt AI-powered development tools and practices Experience defining reusable architecture patterns for shared enterprise AI capabilities Experience mentoring architects or leading architecture communities of practice Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or related field What Success Looks Like Business units have a strong architecture partner for AI-driven product and platform decisions The organization has clearer standards and reusable patterns for AI solutions Teams adopt AI technologies faster and more safely AI initiatives are better aligned to business value, enterprise platforms, and engineering standards Engineering teams are better equipped to use AI-powered PDLC capabilities effectively and responsibly Leadership Expectations This role is expected to operate as a senior technical leader across organizational boundaries. The Principal Architect will influence strategy, guide major technical decisions, coach others, and help establish the technical direction for enterprise AI adoption and architecture excellence. Location: Remote –Bengaluru, KA Scheduled Weekly Hours: 40 If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements.
